title: Etaleness at a point descends along a faithfully flat field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], x\in X, and x_K\in X_K a point above x. If the base-change morphism f_K:X_K\to Y_K [def-pc-base-change] is etale at x_K in the standard pointwise sense, then f is etale at x in the same sense. Here etale at a point means that after choosing affine neighbourhoods Spec B of x and Spec A of f(x), with q the prime of B for x, the map A\to B is finitely presented and its localization at q is flat with zero module of relative differentials; equivalently, some open neighbourhood of x is etale over Y.

source.place: pointwise analogue of Descent, Tag 02VN (etale is fpqc local on the base), using Varieties, Tag 0C4Y (\mathcal{O}_{X,x}\to\mathcal{O}_{X_K,x_K} faithfully flat); no Stacks tag states the pointwise version

proof.text: Choose affine open neighbourhoods Spec B of x in X and Spec A of f(x) in Y with f restricting to Spec(B) \to Spec(A), and let q be the prime of B corresponding to x. The point x_K determines a prime q_K of B \otimes_k K over q. Since f_K is etale on an open neighbourhood of x_K, it is locally of finite presentation on that neighbourhood [def-weil-etale-morphism]; the pointwise field-extension descent lemma [lem-sc-lfp-field-extension-pointwise-descent] therefore lets us shrink the chosen affine neighbourhoods so that B is finitely presented over A. The standard affine characterization of etaleness at q_K then gives the child hypothesis Algebra.IsEtaleAt (A \otimes_k K) q_K.

source.place: Tag 0C4Y setup; affine-local characterization of locally finite presentation and etale morphisms

proof.text: By Tag 0C4Y the local map B_q \to (B \otimes_k K)_{q_K} is faithfully flat (this is what the cited descent statement rests on; its hypotheses are: B finitely presented over the k-algebra A, q_K a prime of B \otimes_k K contracting to q, and Algebra.IsEtaleAt (A \otimes_k K) q_K, all supplied by Step 1). Applying [lem-sc-etale-local-ring-faithfully-flat-descent] to the finitely presented A-algebra B and the prime q_K descends Algebra.IsEtaleAt to q. The standard affine characterization then supplies an etale open neighbourhood of x, so f is etale at x.
